name: magus-console
description: The magus native console: a standalone, decoupled tabbed + tiling PWA that hosts the log viewer, graph explorer, dashboard, and activity trail as live lenses on the server over loopback. Built independently of the docs site (no scribe templating); its output is slipped into the reserved /console/ path. Managed with pnpm (pinned in mise.toml), .npmrc's minimum-release-age is the supply-chain guard.
